en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_politician:
The car winds up the Hakone road and stops in front of a ryokan's detached villa.
The councillor's shoes are already lined up in the entryway. Bowing, the proprietress leads $party.name$ deep along the veranda -
from tonight on, she is the villa's "accompanying secretary", until the negotiation is over.
en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_producer:
In a rented meeting room above the agency, the fill lights are already set up.
The man who calls himself the president skims $party.name$'s file, looks up with a smile, and points at the open floor in the middle of the room.
This is where the "final interview" begins.
en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_sm_master:
The car turns into an unremarkable suburban mansion. The basement lights are on; the leather gear on the walls is sorted by body part, like an anatomy chart.
The old man in a cardigan adjusts his reading glasses and points at the weekly timetable filling the whiteboard.
$party.name$'s week has already been paid for.
en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_sports:
The hotel suite is crowded with tall foreign players. The team manager skims the contract and tips his chin at $party.name$.
The interpreter relays only half of what is said. From tonight on, she is the squad's "team attendant" - training, games and hotel, always with the team.
en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_celeb:
The midnight car stops at the hotel's back entrance. The driver lowers his window and holds out a keycard.
"The clients on the top floor asked for a guide by name. Go on up - don't keep them waiting."
Her phone buzzes twice. The agency's text puts it plainly: for the next few days she is the foreign stars' personal guide; whatever the clients want, she provides; the interest knocked off the debt depends on how happy they are.
$party.name$ reads it through, knuckles whitening around the keycard. The elevator doors open in front of her.
en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_household:
At the gate of the west-city manor, the housekeeper in a grey dress hands her an apron and a handwritten timetable.
"In this house you have no name. Everyone calls you 'little sis'."
$party.name$ looks down at the schedule - up at five thirty in the morning. Days off: none.
en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_gang:
The whole top floor of the old inn has been booked out. The corridor reeks of smoke; in the room, seven or eight footsoldiers are gathered around a low table playing cards.
The young lieutenant slaps $party.name$'s contract down on the table:
"Boys - this week's prize has arrived.\
en-us.event_erav_clients_begin_fallback:
The car stops in front of an unfamiliar building.
The Kiryu-gumi men lead $party.name$ inside, and the door closes silently behind her.
From today on, this is where she works off the debt.
